title: Rust: Audit lichen-* crates against anti-griefing spec updates
description:
After spec beads under worker6-h4pl are complete, sweep Rust implementation:

Check each table/limit in lichen-link, lichen-schc, lichen-gateway:
- Trust store bounds
- Fragment context bounds  
- Replay window bounds
- Claim processing rate limits
- Any table with LRU eviction requirement

For each: verify const/config exists with spec-compliant default, or add it.

Depends on: all spec beads under worker6-h4pl
